before_stage13_pin.evidence_mode: Frozen records preserved without altering any previously captured fields.

frozen_manifest_provenance.basis: Tree hash, runtime dirty flag, launch caps and commit/build association supplied by the smoke operator. This helper rehashes the harness and both main.js copies, but does not recompute the entire runtime tree hash.

before_stage13_pin.coverage_basis: Operator confirms the later harness change affects only stage 13. These completed stages are outside stage 13 and retain their original commit and harness/tree hashes.

corrected_stage13_pin.evidence_mode: Live log snapshots associated with this source cohort by the smoke operator.
corrected_stage13_pin.change_from_previous_cohort: Only tools/smoke_renderer.mjs stage-13 exact ordinary Full pin changes from 3605000 to 3630000, plus its comment. The harness and runtime tree hashes changed; they are not claimed unchanged.
corrected_stage13_pin.application_continuity_basis: Operator reports application and published mirror unchanged. This refresh independently verifies both main.js hashes and mirror build identity; it does not recompute a whole-application hash.

provenance.basis: Each record carries its operator-associated source cohort. Runtime tree hash, dirty flag, changelog hash, launch caps and commit/build association are supplied by the smoke operator. This helper independently rehashes the current harness, both main.js copies, frozen logs and frozen manifest, and reads HEAD and build.json. It does not recompute the entire runtime tree or changelog hash.

notes: A missing log is not_run, never a zero-check pass.
A log without its complete terminal summary is running or incomplete even when individual checks passed.
The capped desktop 5 log is retained separately and contributes no successful stage coverage.
Hashes of running logs describe the bytes read at this refresh and will change as output arrives.
Frozen earlier passes are not relabeled with the later HEAD, harness hash or runtime tree hash.
Zero-error counts come from explicit passing assertions, never from absence of an error line.
Desktop 13 keeps an attempts array. Coverage and completed totals use only its latest existing attempt; a future retry never changes the earlier capped result.
Each live-parsed log records its last substantive check, last check and last nonempty line. An incomplete retry is not automatically attributed to its time cap without operator evidence.
